sloka: तानि रामाय दत्तानि मयैवोपहृतानि च ।स्वनवन्त्यवकीर्णानि तस्मिन् विगतचेतसि ।। ५.३५.३९।।।।
transliteration: tāni rāmāya dattāni mayaivopahṛtāni ca ।svanavantyavakīrṇāni tasmin vigatacetasi ।। 5.35.39।।।।

translations.english: "I collected the ornaments and gave them to Rama. He lost his senses on seeing the jingling ornaments scattered.
